subject: Din's Fire
text: Din's Fire is obtained from the Great Fairy of Magic in Hyrule Castle Grounds, whose fountain is found behind a boulder in a cranny.

evidence.quote:
The Great Fairy of Magic in Hyrule Castle Grounds gives you this 
 ability. Her fountain is found behind a boulder in a cranny.

subject: Farore's Wind
text: Farore's Wind is obtained from the Great Fairy of Magic in Zora's Fountain, whose fountain is behind Jabu-Jabu behind a bombable wall on a small piece of land with boulders.

evidence.quote:
The Great Fairy of Magic in Zora's Fountain gives you this ability. Her
 fountain is found behind Jabu-Jabu, hidden behind a weak, bombable wall on a
 small piece of land with a couple boulders.

subject: Megaton Hammer
text: The Megaton Hammer is gotten in the Fire Temple and is able to break tough materials as well as pound heavy or rusted switches.

evidence.quote:
This powerful hammer is able to break
 the toughest of materials, and is also used to pound heavy or rusted switches....Gotten: In the Fire Temple.

subject: Nayru's Love
text: Nayru's Love is obtained from the Great Fairy of Magic at Desert Colossus, whose fountain is found behind a cracked wall between two palm trees near the Haunted Wasteland entrance.

evidence.quote:
The Great Fairy of Magic at the Desert Colossus gives you this ability.
 Her fountain can be found behind a cracked wall between two palm trees, close
 to the entrance to the Haunted Wasteland.

subject: Empty Bottle
text: An Empty Bottle is rewarded for completing the Super Cucco Finding Game in Lon Lon Ranch after meeting Princess Zelda and waking Talon.

evidence.quote:
You get this bottle by completing the Super Cucco Finding Game in Lon 
 Lon Ranch. You'll have to meet Princess Zelda first. (Which, in other words,
 means waking up Talon, who hosts the little game in the ranch.)

subject: Empty Bottle
text: An Empty Bottle is obtained by finding all the Cuccos for the lady in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
You get this bottle by finding all the Cuccos for the lady in Kakariko 
 Village.

subject: Empty Bottle
text: An Empty Bottle containing a Letter is found underwater in Lake Hylia near the entrance to Zora's Domain, requiring the Silver Scale to dive down to grab it.

evidence.quote:
You can find this underwater in Lake Hylia near the entrance to Zora's 
 Domain. You need the Silver Scale to dive down low enough to grab it. You 
 can't use this bottle immediately, as it already has a Letter inside.

subject: Empty Bottle
text: An Empty Bottle is obtained by hunting Big Poes on horseback in Hyrule Field with the Fairy Bow and taking them to the Ghost Shop in Hyrule Market.

evidence.quote:
Once you have the Fairy Bow, go Big Poe hunting in Hyrule Field on 
 horseback after emptying your bottles. Take the bottled Big Poes to the Ghost 
 Shop in Hyrule Market.

subject: Kokiri Sword
text: The Kokiri Sword is gotten at the end of the mini-maze with the boulder in Kokiri Village.

evidence.quote: At the end of the mini-maze with the boulder in Kokiri Village.

subject: Master Sword
text: The Master Sword is waiting in the Temple of Time after getting the three Spiritual Stones.

evidence.quote:
It's waiting for you in the Temple of Time after getting the three
 Spiritual Stones.

subject: Giant's Knife
text: The Giant's Knife can be bought from Biggoron in Goron City, but it easily breaks and requires two hands to wield.

evidence.quote:
Much more powerful than the Master Sword, but it easily breaks. It
 is wielded with two hands, so no shield use....Gotten: Buy one from the Biggoron in Goron City.

subject: Biggoron's Sword
text: Biggoron's Sword is obtained by completing the adult trading sequence, and can be acquired before the Forest Temple by buying Blue Fire with the Giant's Wallet in Kakariko to thaw King Zora.

evidence.quote:
By completing the
 lengthy trading sequence for Adult Link....It's  actually possible to get this 
 sword before the Forest Temple! Know how you need to thaw the Zora King? Well,
 once you get the Giant's Wallet, just buy some Blue Fire from like, Kakariko's
 shop and free him then, instead of having to go through the Ice Cavern.

subject: Deku Shield
text: The Deku Shield can be bought at the Kokiri Shop, but it burns up on contact with fire.

evidence.quote:
This can withstand
 many attacks, but burns up on contact with fire....Gotten: Buy it at the Kokiri Shop.

subject: Hylian Shield
text: The Hylian Shield can be bought at the Bazaar in Hyrule Market, or gotten for free in the Graveyard by pulling the gravestone with flowers in front and opening the chest down the hole.

evidence.quote:
There are two ways. You can buy it at the Bazaar in Hyrule Market, 
 or you can get it for free in the Graveyard by pulling the gravestone with 
 flowers in front, then dropping down the hole and opening the chest.

subject: Mirror Shield
text: The Mirror Shield is found inside a chest on the left hand of the Desert Colossus after defeating the other Iron Knuckle as Adult Link.

evidence.quote:
After defeating the other Iron Knuckle as Adult Link, you'll find
 a chest containing this on the left hand of the Desert Collosus.

subject: Bigger Bullet Bag
text: The Bigger Bullet Bag holds 40 Deku Seeds and is obtained by scoring three perfect hits of 100 per hit on the target in Lost Woods.

evidence.quote:
This holds 40 Deku Seeds; 10 more than what you 
 normally carry....Gotten: Score three perfect hits on the target in Lost Woods (100 per
 hit).

subject: Biggest Bullet Bag
text: The Biggest Bullet Bag holds 50 Deku Seeds and is won by shooting all the Rupees in one try at Hyrule Market's Shooting Gallery.

evidence.quote:
This is a bullet bag that can be won in Hyrule Market's
 Shooting Gallery. This hold 50 Deku Seeds; very helpful indeed.
Gotten: In the Shooting Gallery, shoot all the Rupees in one try.

subject: Adult's Wallet
text: The Adult's Wallet holds 200 Rupees and is given by the first uncursed man in Kakariko Village's Skulltula House after killing 10 Gold Skulltulas.

evidence.quote:
This is a wallet able to hold 200 Rupees as opposed to 99.
Gotten: Talk to the first man who's curse has been broken in Kakariko Village's 
 Skulltula house and he'll reward you with this item. You must have killed 10
 Gold Skulltulas before you can get this.

subject: Bomb Bag
text: The Bomb Bag holds 20 bombs and is found inside a large treasure chest at the north of the spike trap room in Dodongo's Cavern.

evidence.quote:
This holds 20
 bombs.
Gotten: Inside a large treasure chest at the north of the spike trap room in 
 Dodongo's Cavern.

subject: Bigger Bomb Bag
text: The Bigger Bomb Bag holds 30 Bombs and is obtained by stopping the Hot Rodder Goron with a Bomb under the enclosure in Goron City.

evidence.quote:
This is a bomb bag that'll allow you to carry 30 Bombs.
Gotten: Once you get Bombs, head to Goron City, and stop the Hot Rodder Goron 
 with a Bomb while under the enclosure. He'll give you this in return.

subject: Bullet Bag
text: The Bullet Bag holds 30 Deku Seeds and is received with the Fairy Slingshot.

evidence.quote: A bullet bag that holds 30 Deku Seeds....You get this with the Fairy Slingshot.

subject: Normal Wallet
text: The Normal Wallet holds 99 Rupees and is in Link's possession as the game begins.

evidence.quote: This is a wallet able to hold 99 Rupees....Link has this as you begin the game.

subject: Giant's Wallet
text: The Giant's Wallet holds up to 500 Rupees and is acquired at Kakariko Village's Skulltula House after collecting 30 Gold Skulltulas.

evidence.quote:
This is a wallet that can hold up to 500 Rupees....Collect 30 Gold Skulltulas then head to Kakariko Village's Skulltula 
 House to acquire this prize.

subject: Biggest Bomb Bag
text: The Biggest Bomb Bag lets Link carry 40 Bombs and is a random prize that can be won at Bombchu Bowling Alley in Hyrule Market.

evidence.quote:
This is a bomb bag that lets you carry 40 Bombs....In Bombchu Bowling Alley in Hyrule Market, this is one of the random 
 prizes you can win.
